answer: A milestone bond pays on delivery: each identity posts a 70-credit bond, filing one timber beam at a sable-marked depot by a raven deadline. The auditor weighs the beam against a public table; a short, late, or reused beam burns the bond. First milestone 40, the k-th 40+8(k-1): 1,000 fakes owe 4,036,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. A rented-beam ring fails: one beam cannot serve two. An honest agent pays 40 once, bond returned.
